variants.title: Heller Flusskies
variants.detail: Rounded and softly irregular fine river pebbles, dense with a little fine sand between stones. Warm beige-grey with a few muted slate-grey pebbles. Slightly lighter than other variants but still muted midtone: aim overall RGB 130,120,105, never pale cream.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production source art for Fragdachse ground material. Generate ONE square full-bleed opaque RGB gravel texture, preferably 1536x1536. Strict orthographic vertical 90-degree top-down, no perspective or horizon. Whole image represents EIGHT by EIGHT METRES, displayed at 256x256 world pixels, 32 pixels/metre. This is a wide ground sample, NOT a closeup of large stones.
Scale is critical: overwhelmingly 2–6 cm stones (0.25–0.75 percent of image width), some 8–15 cm (1–1.875 percent), very rare 20 cm (2.5 percent). No object larger than 30 cm. Thousands of small stones distributed evenly across entire image. Dense natural irregular gravel with fine sand and mineral grit in interstices, never fitted paving.
Style: slightly stylized near-realistic hand-painted game material, soft natural edges, legible moderate local contrast; no black outlines, no pixel art, no artificial sharpening, no noisy white speckles.
Lighting: perfectly diffuse neutral albedo-like lighting, no directional cast shadows, no highlights or reflections; only very soft shallow contact shading. Muted warm beige-grey/light brown, overall average sRGB around 125,115,100 (#7d7364), not pale luminous gravel. Few grey or muted blue-grey stones and occasional warm ochre stones, evenly scattered, no standout rocks. Extremely restrained broad brightness variation, NO cloudy patches.
MUST be seamlessly tileable in BOTH horizontal and vertical directions: matching edge density, colour, scale and structures. Uniform field to every edge, no seams or borders, no vignette, fully opaque with no alpha. No grass, moss, plants, leaves, roots, twigs, paths, tracks, puddles, large isolated forms, conspicuous spots, patterns, text, labels or panels. Output only the finished single texture.
Variant: Rounded and softly irregular fine river pebbles, dense with a little fine sand between stones. Warm beige-grey with a few muted slate-grey pebbles. Slightly lighter than other variants but still muted midtone: aim overall RGB 130,120,105, never pale cream.

variants.title: Grauer Schotterkies
variants.detail: Small irregular angular crushed gravel, fine mineral grit in gaps, natural unfitted arrangement. Warm grey with a mild brown mineral undertone, rare blue-grey and ochre fragments. Aim overall RGB 120,116,107. Readable shallow angular facets without hard highlights.

variants.title: Sandiger Kies
variants.detail: Sandier companion material for large-scale blending: about 45 percent visible warm fine mineral sand and grit, about 55 percent embedded small rounded and subangular pebbles. Even mixture everywhere, no bare sand patches or stone clusters. Aim overall RGB 126,114,96. Quiet soft texture, never noisy speckling.

variants.title: Dunkler feuchter Kies
variants.detail: Slightly damp fine rounded and subangular gravel with compact dark sandy grit in narrow interstices. Uniformly darker muted warm grey-brown, overall RGB 110,103,91. Dampness shown ONLY by darker material pigmentation; absolutely matte, no water, puddles, specular highlights or wet reflections.
